summary: AN2 Therapeutics, Inc. files an 8-K under Items 7.01 and 8.01 to disclose positive results from studies of its oral CPSF3 inhibitor, AN2-502998, for chronic Chagas disease. The filing includes no financial terms, no special-situation corporate action, and no recommendation or advisor. A non-human primate study showed 100% parasite elimination with durable effect, and the Phase 1 trial was well-tolerated with target exposures met. This is a routine clinical-progress press release that does not constitute a special situation. The filing merely updates investors on drug development milestones, with no transaction, activist campaign, restructuring, or reclassification event.
